title: Structural Effect of Phosphoramidate Derivatives on the Thermal and Flame Retardant Behaviors of Treated Cotton Cellulose
source_fabric_pretreatment: Testfabrics Style 423; desized, bleached, free of resins and finishes
treatment_method: Dissolve EHP in minimum 1:4 acetone/water; soak fabric flat for 1 h; pad at 10 psi; dry at 100 C for 5 min; cure in air at 170 C for 5 min; cool in a desiccator to room temperature and weigh immediately.
add_on_unit: wt% relative to fabric before treatment
TGA_specimen_preparation: fabric aliquot; cutting or grinding not reported
onset_definition: Author-reported beginning of weight loss; not a percentage-loss threshold or DTG maximum. First onset retained in Tonset_C.
TG_locator: Official Supporting Information Table S2, p S10: onset stages and char residue at 600 C in nitrogen.
LOI_locator: Main Table 2, p 4718: mean LOI, reported plus/minus and trial count.
pairing_evidence: Tables 1 and 2, Figure 3 and official SI Table S2 identify the same EHP/MHP treatment and after-cure add-on sample codes. No durability washing is applied; conclusion explicitly leaves laundering to future work.
source_location: Original author-uploaded main article, pp 4715-4724, Table 2; official publisher SI Table S2.
limitations: Original author-uploaded main fulltext reviewed as text. Official 12-page SI downloaded; Table S2 pixels independently inspected. Main PDF pixels are not claimed. Table 3 Tmax is the MCC maximum heat-release temperature and is excluded from TG fields. TGA-FTIR gas-band temperatures are not TG decomposition metrics. The EHP-20 second onset is 258 C in Table S2 while main text describes approximately 259 C major mass loss; that second stage is withheld from clean numeric fields. LOI plus/minus uncertainty type is not explicitly labeled in Table 2 and remains source-native metadata. Control lacks a reported exact LOI in Table 2; neat compounds are not textile states.
